description: Step 3 of the Kia MFA bootstrap (cmm/verifyOTP): exchange the passcode for a session. The resulting remember-me token is stored locally and is NOT returned — from here on every Kia tool refreshes its own session silently and MFA is never needed again on this device. Takes the `otpKey` and `xid` from kia_start_login plus the code the user received.

otp.description: The one-time passcode Kia sent to the user — 6 digits in every observed case.

xid.description: The `xid` returned by kia_start_login. Sent with every OTP call.

name: kia_verify_otp
